lines.text: ਸੋਚੈ ਸੋਚਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸੋਚੀ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.translation: Even if one bathes hundreds of thousands of times, the mind does not become cleansed.
lines.transliteration: sochai soch na hoviee je sochee lakh vaar ||

lines.text: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੁਪ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਲਾਇ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
lines.translation: By remaining silent, inner silence is not obtained, even by remaining lovingly absorbed deep within.
lines.transliteration: chupai chup na hoviee je lai rahaa liv taar ||

lines.text: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੀ ਜੇ ਬੰਨਾ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਭਾਰ ॥
lines.translation: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased, even by piling up loads of worldly goods.
lines.transliteration: bhukhiaa bhukh na utaree je ba(n)naa pureeaa bhaar ||

lines.text: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਤ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.translation: Hundreds of thousands of clever tricks, but not even one of them will go along with you in the end.
lines.transliteration: sahas siaanapaa lakh hoh ta ik na chalai naal ||

lines.text: ਕਿਵ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਿਵ ਕੂੜੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਪਾਲਿ ॥
lines.translation: So how can you become truthful? And how can the veil of falsehood be torn away?
lines.transliteration: kiv sachiaaraa hoieeaai kiv kooRai tuTai paal ||

lines.text: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.translation: O Nanak, it is written that you shall obey the Hukam of His Command, and walk in the Way of His Will. ||1||
lines.transliteration: hukam rajaiee chalanaa naanak likhiaa naal ||1||

lines.text: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਆਕਾਰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.translation: By His Command, bodies are created; His Command cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: hukamee hovan aakaar hukam na kahiaa jaiee ||

lines.text: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਜੀਅ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.translation: By His Command, souls come into being; by His Command, glory and greatness are obtained.
lines.transliteration: hukamee hovan jeea hukam milai vaddiaaiee ||

lines.text: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਉਤਮੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
lines.translation: By His Command, some are high and some are low; by His Written Command, pain and pleasure are obtained.
lines.transliteration: hukamee utam neech hukam likh dhukh sukh paie'eeh ||

lines.text: ਇਕਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਇਕਿ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
lines.translation: Some, by His Command, are blessed and forgiven; others, by His Command, wander aimlessly forever.
lines.transliteration: eikanaa hukamee bakhasees ik hukamee sadhaa bhavaie'eeh ||

lines.text: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.translation: Everyone is subject to His Command; no one is beyond His Command.
lines.transliteration: hukamai a(n)dhar sabh ko baahar hukam na koi ||

lines.text: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੇ ਬੁਝੈ ਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who understands His Command, does not speak in ego. ||2||
lines.transliteration: naanak hukamai je bujhai ta haumai kahai na koi ||2||

lines.text: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
lines.translation: Some sing of His Power-who has that Power?
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko taan hovai kisai taan ||

lines.translation: Some sing of His Gifts, and know His Sign and Insignia.
Some sing of His Glorious Virtues, Greatness and Beauty.
Some sing of knowledge obtained of Him, through difficult philosophical studies.

lines.text: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
lines.translation: Some sing that He fashions the body, and then again reduces it to dust.
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko saaj kare tan kheh ||

lines.text: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜੀਅ ਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.translation: Some sing that He takes life away, and then again restores it.
lines.transliteration: gaavai ko jeea lai fir dheh ||

lines.translation: Some sing that He seems so very far away.
Some sing that He watches over us, face to face, ever-present.
There is no shortage of those who preach and teach.

lines.text: ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਕਥੀ ਕੋਟੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
lines.translation: Millions upon millions offer millions of sermons and stories.
lines.transliteration: kath kath kathee koTee koT koT ||

lines.translation: The Great Giver keeps on giving, while those who receive grow weary of receiving.
Throughout the ages, consumers consume.
The Commander, by His Command, leads us to walk on the Path.
O Nanak, He blossoms forth, Carefree and Untroubled. ||3||

lines.text: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਇ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.translation: True is the Master, True is His Name-speak it with infinite love.
lines.transliteration: saachaa saahib saach nai bhaakhiaa bhaau apaar ||

lines.text: ਆਖਹਿ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.translation: People beg and pray, ""Give to us, give to us"", and the Great Giver gives His Gifts.
lines.transliteration: aakheh ma(n)geh dheh dheh dhaat kare dhaataar ||

lines.text: ਫੇਰਿ ਕਿ ਅਗੈ ਰਖੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.translation: So what offering can we place before Him, by which we might see the Darbaar of His Court?
lines.transliteration: fer k agai rakheeaai jit dhisai dharabaar ||

lines.text: ਮੁਹੌ ਕਿ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.translation: What words can we speak to evoke His Love?
lines.transliteration: muhau k bolan boleeaai jit sun dhare piaar ||

lines.text: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.translation: In the Amrit Vaylaa, the ambrosial hours before dawn, chant the True Name, and contemplate His Glorious Greatness.
lines.transliteration: a(n)mirat velaa sach naau vaddiaaiee veechaar ||

lines.text: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਵੈ ਕਪੜਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੋਖੁ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.translation: By the karma of past actions, the robe of this physical body is obtained. By His Grace, the Gate of Liberation is found.
lines.transliteration: karamee aavai kapaRaa nadharee mokh dhuaar ||

lines.text: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥
lines.translation: O Nanak, know this well: the True One Himself is All. ||4||
lines.transliteration: naanak evai jaaneeaai sabh aape sachiaar ||4||

lines.text: ਥਾਪਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕੀਤਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.translation: He cannot be established, He cannot be created.
lines.transliteration: thaapiaa na jai keetaa na hoi ||

lines.translation: He Himself is Immaculate and Pure.
Those who serve Him are honored.
O Nanak, sing of the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.
Sing, and listen, and let your mind be filled with love.

lines.text: ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.translation: Your pain shall be sent far away, and peace shall come to your home.
lines.transliteration: dhukh parahar sukh ghar lai jai ||

lines.text: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਦੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.translation: The Guru's Word is the Sound-current of the Naad; the Guru's Word is the Wisdom of the Vedas; the Guru's Word is all-pervading.
lines.transliteration: gurmukh naadha(n) gurmukh vedha(n) gurmukh rahiaa samaiee ||

lines.text: ਗੁਰੁ ਈਸਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬਤੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
lines.translation: The Guru is Shiva, the Guru is Vishnu and Brahma; the Guru is Paarvati and Lakhshmi.
lines.transliteration: gur ieesar gur gorakh baramaa gur paarabatee maiee ||

lines.text: ਜੇ ਹਉ ਜਾਣਾ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.translation: Even knowing God, I cannot describe Him; He cannot be described in words.
lines.transliteration: je hau jaanaa aakhaa naahee kahanaa kathan na jaiee ||

lines.translation: The Guru has given me this one understanding:

lines.text: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
lines.translation: there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||5||
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa ik dhaataa so mai visar na jaiee ||5||

lines.text: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਕਿ ਨਾਇ ਕਰੀ ॥
lines.translation: If I am pleasing to Him, then that is my pilgrimage and cleansing bath. Without pleasing Him, what good are ritual cleansings?
lines.transliteration: teerath naavaa je tis bhaavaa vin bhaane k nai karee ||

lines.text: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਰਠਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਵੇਖਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਈ ॥
lines.translation: I gaze upon all the created beings: without the karma of good actions, what are they given to receive?
lines.transliteration: jetee siraTh upaiee vekhaa vin karamaa k milai liee ||

lines.text: ਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਜੇ ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀ ॥
lines.translation: Within the mind are gems, jewels and rubies, if you listen to the Guru's Teachings, even once.
lines.transliteration: mat vich ratan javaahar maanik je ik gur kee sikh sunee ||

lines.translation: The Guru has given me this one understanding:

lines.text: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.translation: there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||6||
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa ik dhaataa so mai visar na jaiee ||6||

lines.text: ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਆਰਜਾ ਹੋਰ ਦਸੂਣੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.translation: Even if you could live throughout the four ages, or even ten times more,
lines.transliteration: je jug chaare aarajaa hor dhasoonee hoi ||

lines.text: ਨਵਾ ਖੰਡਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.translation: and even if you were known throughout the nine continents and followed by all,
lines.transliteration: navaa kha(n)ddaa vich jaaneeaai naal chalai sabh koi ||

lines.text: ਚੰਗਾ ਨਾਉ ਰਖਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਗਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.translation: with a good name and reputation, with praise and fame throughout the world-
lines.transliteration: cha(n)gaa naau rakhai kai jas keerat jag lei ||

lines.text: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤ ਵਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੇ ॥
lines.translation: still, if the Lord does not bless you with His Glance of Grace, then who cares? What is the use?
lines.transliteration: je tis nadhar na aaviee ta vaat na puchhai ke ||

lines.text: ਕੀਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਸੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
lines.translation: Among worms, you would be considered a lowly worm, and even contemptible sinners would hold you in contempt.
lines.transliteration: keeTaa a(n)dhar keeT kar dhosee dhos dhare ||

lines.text: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਦੇ ॥
lines.translation: O Nanak, God blesses the unworthy with virtue, and bestows virtue on the virtuous.
lines.transliteration: naanak niragun gun kare gunava(n)tiaa gun dhe ||

lines.text: ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਜਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇ ॥੭॥
lines.translation: No one can even imagine anyone who can bestow virtue upon Him. ||7||
lines.transliteration: tehaa koi na sujhiee j tis gun koi kare ||7||

lines.translation: Listening-the Siddhas, the spiritual teachers, the heroic warriors, the yogic masters.
Listening-the earth, its support and the Akaashic ethers.
Listening-the oceans, the lands of the world and the nether regions of the underworld.
Listening-Death cannot even touch you.
O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.
Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||8||
Listening-Shiva, Brahma and Indra.
Listening-even foul-mouthed people praise Him.
Listening-the technology of Yoga and the secrets of the body.
Listening-the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas.
O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.
Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||9||
Listening-truth, contentment and spiritual wisdom.
Listening-take your cleansing bath at the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage.
Listening-reading and reciting, honor is obtained.
Listening-intuitively grasp the essence of meditation.
O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.
Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||10||
Listening-dive deep into the ocean of virtue.
Listening-the Shaykhs, religious scholars, spiritual teachers and emperors.
Listening-even the blind find the Path.
Listening-the Unreachable comes within your grasp.
O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.
Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||11||

lines.text: ਮੰਨੇ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.translation: The state of the faithful cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: ma(n)ne kee gat kahee na jai ||

lines.translation: One who tries to describe this shall regret the attempt.
No paper, no pen, no scribe
can record the state of the faithful.
Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

lines.text: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.translation: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||12||
lines.transliteration: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||12||

lines.translation: The faithful have intuitive awareness and intelligence.
The faithful know about all worlds and realms.
The faithful shall never be struck across the face.

lines.text: ਮੰਨੈ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.translation: The faithful do not have to go with the Messenger of Death.
lines.transliteration: ma(n)nai jam kai saath na jai ||

lines.translation: Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

lines.text: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.translation: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||13||
lines.transliteration: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||13||

lines.translation: The path of the faithful shall never be blocked.
The faithful shall depart with honor and fame.
The faithful do not follow empty religious rituals.
The faithful are firmly bound to the Dharma.
Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

lines.text: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.translation: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||14||
lines.transliteration: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||14||

lines.translation: The faithful find the Door of Liberation.
The faithful uplift and redeem their family and relations.
The faithful are saved, and carried across with the Sikhs of the Guru.
The faithful, O Nanak, do not wander around begging.
Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

lines.text: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.translation: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||15||
lines.transliteration: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||15||

lines.translation: The chosen ones, the self-elect, are accepted and approved.
The chosen ones are honored in the Court of the Lord.
The chosen ones look beautiful in the courts of kings.
The chosen ones meditate single-mindedly on the Guru.
No matter how much anyone tries to explain and describe them,
the actions of the Creator cannot be counted.
The mythical bull is Dharma, the son of compassion;
this is what patiently holds the earth in its place.
One who understands this becomes truthful.
What a great load there is on the bull!
So many worlds beyond this world-so very many!

lines.text: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਭਾਰੁ ਤਲੈ ਕਵਣੁ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
lines.translation: What power holds them, and supports their weight?
lines.transliteration: tis te bhaar talai kavan jor ||

lines.translation: The names and the colors of the assorted species of beings
were all inscribed by the Ever-flowing Pen of God.
Who knows how to write this account?
Just imagine what a huge scroll it would take!
What power! What fascinating beauty!
And what gifts! Who can know their extent?
You created the vast expanse of the Universe with One Word!
Hundreds of thousands of rivers began to flow.
How can Your Creative Potency be described?
I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

lines.text: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.translation: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai saiee bhalee kaar ||

lines.translation: You, Eternal and Formless One! ||16||
Countless meditations, countless loves.
Countless worship services, countless austere disciplines.
Countless scriptures, and ritual recitations of the Vedas.
Countless Yogis, whose minds remain detached from the world.
Countless devotees contemplate the Wisdom and Virtues of the Lord.
Countless the holy, countless the givers.
Countless heroic spiritual warriors, who bear the brunt of the attack in battle (who with their mouths eat steel).
Countless silent sages, vibrating the String of His Love.
How can Your Creative Potency be described?
I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

lines.text: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.translation: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai saiee bhalee kaar ||

lines.translation: You, Eternal and Formless One. ||17||
Countless fools, blinded by ignorance.
Countless thieves and embezzlers.
Countless impose their will by force.
Countless cut-throats and ruthless killers.
Countless sinners who keep on sinning.
Countless liars, wandering lost in their lies.
Countless wretches, eating filth as their ration.
Countless slanderers, carrying the weight of their stupid mistakes on their heads.
Nanak describes the state of the lowly.
I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

lines.text: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.translation: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai saiee bhalee kaar ||

lines.translation: You, Eternal and Formless One. ||18||
Countless names, countless places.
Inaccessible, unapproachable, countless celestial realms.
Even to call them countless is to carry the weight on your head.
From the Word, comes the Naam; from the Word, comes Your Praise.
From the Word, comes spiritual wisdom, singing the Songs of Your Glory.
From the Word, come the written and spoken words and hymns.
From the Word, comes destiny, written on one's forehead.

lines.text: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.translation: But the One who wrote these Words of Destiny-no words are written on His Forehead.
lines.transliteration: jin eh likhe tis sir naeh ||

lines.translation: As He ordains, so do we receive.
The created universe is the manifestation of Your Name.
Without Your Name, there is no place at all.
How can I describe Your Creative Power?
I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

lines.text: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.translation: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai saiee bhalee kaar ||

lines.translation: You, Eternal and Formless One. ||19||
When the hands and the feet and the body are dirty,
water can wash away the dirt.
When the clothes are soiled and stained by urine,
soap can wash them clean.
But when the intellect is stained and polluted by sin,
it can only be cleansed by the Love of the Name.
Virtue and vice do not come by mere words;

lines.text: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
lines.translation: actions repeated, over and over again, are engraved on the soul.
lines.transliteration: kar kar karanaa likh lai jaahu ||

lines.translation: You shall harvest what you plant.
O Nanak, by the Hukam of God's Command, we come and go in reincarnation. ||20||
Pilgrimages, austere discipline, compassion and charity

lines.text: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਿਲ ਕਾ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.translation: these, by themselves, bring only an iota of merit.
lines.transliteration: je ko paavai til kaa maan ||

lines.translation: Listening and believing with love and humility in your mind,
cleanse yourself with the Name, at the sacred shrine deep within.

lines.text: ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.translation: All virtues are Yours, Lord, I have none at all.
lines.transliteration: sabh gun tere mai naahee koi ||

lines.text: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.translation: Without virtue, there is no devotional worship.
lines.transliteration: vin gun keete bhagat na hoi ||

lines.translation: I bow to the Lord of the World, to His Word, to Brahma the Creator.
He is Beautiful, True and Eternally Joyful.

lines.text: ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਕਵਣ ਥਿਤਿ ਕਵਣੁ ਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.translation: What was that time, and what was that moment? What was that day, and what was that date?
lines.transliteration: kavanu su velaa vakhat kavan kavan thit kavan vaar ||

lines.text: ਕਵਣਿ ਸਿ ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.translation: What was that season, and what was that month, when the Universe was created?
lines.transliteration: kavan s rutee maahu kavan jit hoaa aakaar ||

lines.text: ਵੇਲ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਪੰਡਤੀ ਜਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
lines.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, cannot find that time, even if it is written in the Puraanas.
lines.transliteration: vel na paieeaa pa(n)ddatee j hovai lekh puraan ||

lines.text: ਵਖਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕਾਦੀਆ ਜਿ ਲਿਖਨਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
lines.translation: That time is not known to the Qazis, who study the Koran.
lines.transliteration: vakhat na paio kaadheeaa j likhan lekh kuraan ||

lines.text: ਥਿਤਿ ਵਾਰੁ ਨਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਰੁਤਿ ਮਾਹੁ ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.translation: The day and the date are not known to the Yogis, nor is the month or the season.
lines.transliteration: thit vaar naa jogee jaanai rut maahu naa koiee ||

lines.text: ਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਿਰਠੀ ਕਉ ਸਾਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.translation: The Creator who created this creation-only He Himself knows.
lines.transliteration: jaa karataa siraThee kau saaje aape jaanai soiee ||

lines.text: ਕਿਵ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਾ ਕਿਵ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਵਰਨੀ ਕਿਵ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.translation: How can we speak of Him? How can we praise Him? How can we describe Him? How can we know Him?
lines.transliteration: kiv kar aakhaa kiv saalaahee kiau varanee kiv jaanaa ||

lines.text: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਣਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਇਕ ਦੂ ਇਕੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
lines.translation: O Nanak, everyone speaks of Him, each one wiser than the rest.
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhan sabh ko aakhai ik dhoo ik siaanaa ||

lines.text: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵਡੀ ਨਾਈ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.translation: Great is the Master, Great is His Name. Whatever happens is according to His Will.
lines.transliteration: vaddaa saahib vaddee naiee keetaa jaa kaa hovai ||

lines.text: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਪੌ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਨ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੨੧॥
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who claims to know everything shall not be decorated in the world hereafter. ||21||
lines.transliteration: naanak je ko aapau jaanai agai giaa na sohai ||21||

lines.translation: There are nether worlds beneath nether worlds, and hundreds of thousands of heavenly worlds above.

lines.text: ਓੜਕ ਓੜਕ ਭਾਲਿ ਥਕੇ ਵੇਦ ਕਹਨਿ ਇਕ ਵਾਤ ॥
lines.translation: The Vedas say that you can search and search for them all, until you grow weary.
lines.transliteration: oRak oRak bhaal thake vedh kahan ik vaat ||

lines.text: ਸਹਸ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਕਹਨਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਅਸੁਲੂ ਇਕੁ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
lines.translation: The scriptures say that there are 18,000 worlds, but in reality, there is only One Universe.
lines.transliteration: sahas aThaareh kahan katebaa asuloo ik dhaat ||

lines.text: ਲੇਖਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਲੇਖੈ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
lines.translation: If you try to write an account of this, you will surely finish yourself before you finish writing it.
lines.transliteration: lekhaa hoi ta likheeaai lekhai hoi vinaas ||

lines.text: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੁ ॥੨੨॥
lines.translation: O Nanak, call Him Great! He Himself knows Himself. ||22||
lines.transliteration: naanak vaddaa aakheeaai aape jaanai aap ||22||

lines.text: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਏਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
lines.translation: The praisers praise the Lord, but they do not obtain intuitive understanding
lines.transliteration: saalaahee saalaeh etee surat na paieeaa ||

lines.text: ਨਦੀਆ ਅਤੈ ਵਾਹ ਪਵਹਿ ਸਮੁੰਦਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ॥
lines.translation: the streams and rivers flowing into the ocean do not know its vastness.
lines.transliteration: nadheeaa atai vaeh paveh samu(n)dh na jaane'eeh ||

lines.text: ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਾਹ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਗਿਰਹਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
lines.translation: Even kings and emperors, with mountains of property and oceans of wealth
lines.transliteration: samu(n)dh saeh sulataan girahaa setee maal dhan ||

lines.text: ਕੀੜੀ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਨੀ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰਹਿ ॥੨੩॥
lines.translation: -these are not even equal to an ant, who does not forget God. ||23||
lines.transliteration: keeRee tul na hovanee je tis manahu na veesareh ||23||

lines.text: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
lines.translation: Endless are His Praises, endless are those who speak them.
lines.transliteration: a(n)t na sifatee kahan na a(n)t ||

lines.text: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਦੇਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
lines.translation: Endless are His Actions, endless are His Gifts.
lines.transliteration: a(n)t na karanai dhen na a(n)t ||

lines.text: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਵੇਖਣਿ ਸੁਣਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
lines.translation: Endless is His Vision, endless is His Hearing.
lines.transliteration: a(n)t na vekhan sunan na a(n)t ||

lines.text: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
lines.translation: His limits cannot be perceived. What is the Mystery of His Mind?
lines.transliteration: a(n)t na jaapai kiaa man ma(n)t ||

lines.translation: The limits of the created universe cannot be perceived.
Its limits here and beyond cannot be perceived.
Many struggle to know His limits,

lines.text: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.translation: but His limits cannot be found.
lines.transliteration: taa ke a(n)t na paae jaeh ||

lines.translation: No one can know these limits.
The more you say about them, the more there still remains to be said.
Great is the Master, High is His Heavenly Home.
Highest of the High, above all is His Name.
Only one as Great and as High as God
can know His Lofty and Exalted State.
Only He Himself is that Great. He Himself knows Himself.
O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, He bestows His Blessings. ||24||
His Blessings are so abundant that there can be no written account of them.
The Great Giver does not hold back anything.
There are so many great, heroic warriors begging at the Door of the Infinite Lord.
So many contemplate and dwell upon Him, that they cannot be counted.
So many waste away to death engaged in corruption.
So many take and take again, and then deny receiving.
So many foolish consumers keep on consuming.
So many endure distress, deprivation and constant abuse.
Even these are Your Gifts, O Great Giver!
Liberation from bondage comes only by Your Will.
No one else has any say in this.
If some fool should presume to say that he does,
he shall learn, and feel the effects of his folly.
He Himself knows, He Himself gives.
Few, very few are those who acknowledge this.
One who is blessed to sing the Praises of the Lord,
O Nanak, is the king of kings. ||25||
Priceless are His Virtues, Priceless are His Dealings.
Priceless are His Dealers, Priceless are His Treasures.
Priceless are those who come to Him, Priceless are those who buy from Him.
Priceless is Love for Him, Priceless is absorption into Him.
Priceless is the Divine Law of Dharma, Priceless is the Divine Court of Justice.
Priceless are the scales, priceless are the weights.
Priceless are His Blessings, Priceless is His Banner and Insignia.
Priceless is His Mercy, Priceless is His Royal Command.
Priceless, O Priceless beyond expression!
Speak of Him continually, and remain absorbed in His Love.
The Vedas and the Puraanas speak.
The scholars speak and lecture.
Brahma speaks, Indra speaks.
The Gopis and Krishna speak.
Shiva speaks, the Siddhas speak.
The many created Buddhas speak.
The demons speak, the demi-gods speak.

lines.text: ਆਖਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵ ॥
lines.translation: The spiritual warriors, the heavenly beings, the silent sages, the humble and serviceful speak.
lines.transliteration: aakheh sur nar mun jan sev ||

lines.translation: Many speak and try to describe Him.

lines.text: ਕੇਤੇ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.translation: Many have spoken of Him over and over again, and have then arisen and departed.
lines.transliteration: kete keh keh uTh uTh jaeh ||

lines.translation: If He were to create as many again as there already are,

lines.text: ਤਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
lines.translation: even then, they could not describe Him.
lines.transliteration: taa aakh na sakeh keiee kei ||

lines.translation: He is as Great as He wishes to be.
O Nanak, the True Lord knows.
If anyone presumes to describe God,
he shall be known as the greatest fool of fools! ||26||

lines.text: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
lines.translation: Where is that Gate, and where is that Dwelling, in which You sit and take care of all?
lines.transliteration: so dhar kehaa so ghar kehaa jit beh sarab samaale ||

lines.text: ਵਾਜੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.translation: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, and countless musicians play on all sorts of instruments there.
lines.transliteration: vaaje naadh anek asa(n)khaa kete vaavanahaare ||

lines.text: ਕੇਤੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.translation: So many Ragas, so many musicians singing there.
lines.transliteration: kete raag paree siau kaheean kete gaavanahaare ||

lines.text: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਹਨੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
lines.translation: The praanic wind, water and fire sing; the Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.
lines.transliteration: gaaveh tuhano paun paanee baisa(n)tar gaavai raajaa dharam dhuaare ||

lines.text: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.translation: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who record actions, and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who judges this record sing.
lines.transliteration: gaaveh chit gupat likh jaaneh likh likh dharam veechaare ||

lines.text: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਈਸਰੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.translation: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned, sing.
lines.transliteration: gaaveh ieesar baramaa dhevee sohan sadhaa savaare ||

lines.text: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਇੰਦ ਇਦਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.translation: Indra, seated upon His Throne, sings with the deities at Your Door.
lines.transliteration: gaaveh i(n)dh idhaasan baiThe dhevatiaa dhar naale ||

lines.text: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.translation: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing; the Saadhus sing in contemplation.
lines.transliteration: gaaveh sidh samaadhee a(n)dhar gaavan saadh vichaare ||

lines.text: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
lines.translation: The celibates, the fanatics, the peacefully accepting and the fearless warriors sing.
lines.transliteration: gaavan jatee satee sa(n)tokhee gaaveh veer karaare ||

lines.text: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਨਿ ਰਖੀਸਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing.
lines.transliteration: gaavan pa(n)ddit paRan rakheesar jug jug vedhaa naale ||

lines.text: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗਾ ਮਛ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
lines.translation: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in this world, in paradise, and in the underworld of the subconscious sing.
lines.transliteration: gaaveh mohaneeaa man mohan suragaa machh piaale ||

lines.text: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.translation: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage sing.
lines.transliteration: gaavan ratan upaae tere aThasaTh teerath naale ||

lines.text: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.translation: The brave and mighty warriors sing; the spiritual heroes and the four sources of creation sing.
lines.transliteration: gaaveh jodh mahaabal sooraa gaaveh khaanee chaare ||

lines.text: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਵਰਭੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.translation: The planets, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing.
lines.transliteration: gaaveh kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal varabha(n)ddaa kar kar rakhe dhaare ||

lines.text: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
lines.translation: They alone sing, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued with the Nectar of Your Essence.
lines.transliteration: seiee tudhuno gaaveh jo tudh bhaavan rate tere bhagat rasaale ||

lines.text: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.translation: So many others sing, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I consider them all?
lines.transliteration: hor kete gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa veechaare ||

lines.text: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
lines.translation: That True Lord is True, Forever True, and True is His Name.
lines.transliteration: soiee soiee sadhaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naiee ||

lines.text: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
lines.translation: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He has created departs.
lines.transliteration: hai bhee hosee jai na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaiee ||

lines.text: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
lines.translation: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya.
lines.transliteration: ra(n)gee ra(n)gee bhaatee kar kar jinasee maiaa jin upaiee ||

lines.text: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਵ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.translation: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.
lines.transliteration: kar kar vekhai keetaa aapanaa jiv tis dhee vaddiaaiee ||

lines.text: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.translation: He does whatever He pleases. No order can be issued to Him.
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaavai soiee karasee hukam na karanaa jaiee ||

lines.text: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੨੭॥
lines.translation: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanak remains subject to His Will. ||27||
lines.transliteration: so paatisaahu saahaa paatisaahib naanak rahan rajaiee ||27||

lines.text: ਮੁੰਦਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ॥
lines.translation: Make contentment your ear-rings, humility your begging bowl, and meditation the ashes you apply to your body.
lines.transliteration: mu(n)dhaa sa(n)tokh saram pat jholee dhiaan kee kareh bibhoot ||

lines.text: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
lines.translation: Let the remembrance of death be the patched coat you wear, let the purity of virginity be your way in the world, and let faith in the Lord be your walking stick.
lines.transliteration: khi(n)thaa kaal kuaaree kaiaa jugat dda(n)ddaa parateet ||

lines.text: ਆਈ ਪੰਥੀ ਸਗਲ ਜਮਾਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਤੈ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤੁ ॥
lines.translation: See the brotherhood of all mankind as the highest order of Yogis; conquer your own mind, and conquer the world.
lines.transliteration: aaiee pa(n)thee sagal jamaatee man jeetai jag jeet ||

lines.translation: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

lines.text: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੮॥
lines.translation: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||28||
lines.transliteration: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||28||

lines.text: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦਇਆ ਭੰਡਾਰਣਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਾਦ ॥
lines.translation: Let spiritual wisdom be your food, and compassion your attendant. The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates in each and every heart.
lines.transliteration: bhugat giaan dhiaa bha(n)ddaaran ghaT ghaT vaajeh naadh ||

lines.text: ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਥੀ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਾਦ ॥
lines.translation: He Himself is the Supreme Master of all; wealth and miraculous spiritual powers, and all other external tastes and pleasures, are all like beads on a string.
lines.transliteration: aap naath naathee sabh jaa kee ridh sidh avaraa saadh ||

lines.text: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਦੁਇ ਕਾਰ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਲੇਖੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਭਾਗ ॥
lines.translation: Union with Him, and separation from Him, come by His Will. We come to receive what is written in our destiny.
lines.transliteration: sa(n)jog vijog dhui kaar chalaaveh lekhe aaveh bhaag ||

lines.translation: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

lines.text: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੯॥
lines.translation: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||29||
lines.transliteration: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||29||

lines.text: ਏਕਾ ਮਾਈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਿਆਈ ਤਿਨਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.translation: The One Divine Mother conceived and gave birth to the three deities.
lines.transliteration: ekaa maiee jugat viaaiee tin chele paravaan ||

lines.text: ਇਕੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਲਾਏ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
lines.translation: One, the Creator of the World; One, the Sustainer; and One, the Destroyer.
lines.transliteration: eik sa(n)saaree ik bha(n)ddaaree ik laae dheebaan ||

lines.text: ਜਿਵ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਜਿਵ ਹੋਵੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.translation: He makes things happen according to the Pleasure of His Will. Such is His Celestial Order.
lines.transliteration: jiv tis bhaavai tivai chalaavai jiv hovai furamaan ||

lines.text: ਓਹੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਓਨਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੁ ॥
lines.translation: He watches over all, but none see Him. How wonderful this is!
lines.transliteration: oh vekhai onaa nadhar na aavai bahutaa eh viddaan ||

lines.translation: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

lines.text: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੦॥
lines.translation: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||30||
lines.transliteration: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||30||

lines.translation: On world after world are His Seats of Authority and His Storehouses.

lines.text: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.translation: Whatever was put into them, was put there once and for all.
lines.transliteration: jo kichh paiaa su ekaa vaar ||

lines.translation: Having created the creation, the Creator Lord watches over it.
O Nanak, True is the Creation of the True Lord.
I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

lines.text: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੧॥
lines.translation: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||31||
lines.transliteration: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||31||

lines.text: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਜੀਭੌ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਲਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਲਖ ਵੀਸ ॥
lines.translation: If I had 100,000 tongues, and these were then multiplied twenty times more, with each tongue,
lines.transliteration: eik dhoo jeebhau lakh hoh lakh hoveh lakh vees ||

lines.text: ਲਖੁ ਲਖੁ ਗੇੜਾ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
lines.translation: I would repeat, hundreds of thousands of times, the Name of the One, the Lord of the Universe.
lines.transliteration: lakh lakh geRaa aakhe'eeh ek naam jagadhees ||

lines.text: ਏਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਵੜੀਆ ਚੜੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਇਕੀਸ ॥
lines.translation: Along this path to our Husband Lord, we climb the steps of the ladder, and come to merge with Him.
lines.transliteration: et raeh pat pavaReeaa chaReeaai hoi ikees ||

lines.text: ਸੁਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਆਕਾਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਟਾ ਆਈ ਰੀਸ ॥
lines.translation: Hearing of the etheric realms, even worms long to come back home.
lines.transliteration: sun galaa aakaas kee keeTaa aaiee rees ||

lines.text: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੈ ਠੀਸ ॥੩੨॥
lines.translation: O Nanak, by His Grace He is obtained. False are the boastings of the false. ||32||
lines.transliteration: naanak nadharee paieeaai kooRee kooRai Thees ||32||

lines.translation: No power to speak, no power to keep silent.

lines.text: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਦੇਣਿ ਨ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
lines.translation: No power to beg, no power to give.
lines.transliteration: jor na ma(n)gan dhen na jor ||

lines.text: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਨਹ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
lines.translation: No power to live, no power to die.
lines.transliteration: jor na jeevan maran neh jor ||

lines.text: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਜਿ ਮਾਲਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਰੁ ॥
lines.translation: No power to rule, with wealth and occult mental powers.
lines.transliteration: jor na raaj maal man sor ||

lines.translation: No power to gain intuitive understanding, spiritual wisdom and meditation.
No power to find the way to escape from the world.

lines.text: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.translation: He alone has the Power in His Hands. He watches over all.
lines.transliteration: jis hath jor kar vekhai soi ||

lines.translation: O Nanak, no one is high or low. ||33||
Nights, days, weeks and seasons;
wind, water, fire and the nether regions

lines.text: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਥਾਪਿ ਰਖੀ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ॥
lines.translation: in the midst of these, He established the earth as a home for Dharma.
lines.transliteration: tis vich dharatee thaap rakhee dharam saal ||

lines.text: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
lines.translation: Upon it, He placed the various species of beings.
lines.transliteration: tis vich jeea jugat ke ra(n)g ||

lines.translation: Their names are uncounted and endless.
By their deeds and their actions, they shall be judged.
God Himself is True, and True is His Court.
There, in perfect grace and ease, sit the self-elect, the self-realized Saints.
They receive the Mark of Grace from the Merciful Lord.
The ripe and the unripe, the good and the bad, shall there be judged.
O Nanak, when you go home, you will see this. ||34||
This is righteous living in the realm of Dharma.
And now we speak of the realm of spiritual wisdom.

lines.text: ਕੇਤੇ ਪਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਵੈਸੰਤਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕਾਨ ਮਹੇਸ ॥
lines.translation: So many winds, waters and fires; so many Krishnas and Shivas.
lines.transliteration: kete pavan paanee vaisa(n)tar kete kaan mahes ||

lines.text: ਕੇਤੇ ਬਰਮੇ ਘਾੜਤਿ ਘੜੀਅਹਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇ ਵੇਸ ॥
lines.translation: So many Brahmas, fashioning forms of great beauty, adorned and dressed in many colors.
lines.transliteration: kete barame ghaaRat ghaRe'eh roop ra(n)g ke ves ||

lines.text: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮੀ ਮੇਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਧੂ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
lines.translation: So many worlds and lands for working out karma. So very many lessons to be learned!
lines.transliteration: keteeaa karam bhoomee mer kete kete dhoo upadhes ||

lines.text: ਕੇਤੇ ਇੰਦ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਡਲ ਦੇਸ ॥
lines.translation: So many Indras, so many moons and suns, so many worlds and lands.
lines.transliteration: kete i(n)dh cha(n)dh soor kete kete ma(n)ddal dhes ||

lines.text: ਕੇਤੇ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਨਾਥ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵੀ ਵੇਸ ॥
lines.translation: So many Siddhas and Buddhas, so many Yogic masters. So many goddesses of various kinds.
lines.transliteration: kete sidh budh naath kete kete dhevee ves ||

lines.text: ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਰਤਨ ਸਮੁੰਦ ॥
lines.translation: So many demi-gods and demons, so many silent sages. So many oceans of jewels.
lines.transliteration: kete dhev dhaanav mun kete kete ratan samu(n)dh ||

lines.text: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ਕੇਤੀਆ ਬਾਣੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਾਤ ਨਰਿੰਦ ॥
lines.translation: So many ways of life, so many languages. So many dynasties of rulers.
lines.transliteration: keteeaa khaanee keteeaa baanee kete paat nari(n)dh ||

lines.text: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੇਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥੩੫॥
lines.translation: So many intuitive people, so many selfless servants. O Nanak, His limit has no limit! ||35||
lines.transliteration: keteeaa suratee sevak kete naanak a(n)t na a(n)t ||35||

lines.translation: In the realm of wisdom, spiritual wisdom reigns supreme.
The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, amidst the sounds and the sights of bliss.
In the realm of humility, the Word is Beauty.
Forms of incomparable beauty are fashioned there.

lines.text: ਤਾ ਕੀਆ ਗਲਾ ਕਥੀਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.translation: These things cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: taa keeaa galaa katheeaa naa jaeh ||

lines.translation: One who tries to speak of these shall regret the attempt.

lines.text: ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
lines.translation: The intuitive consciousness, intellect and understanding of the mind are shaped there.
lines.transliteration: tithai ghaReeaai surat mat man budh ||

lines.text: ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ ਸੁਰਾ ਸਿਧਾ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ॥੩੬॥
lines.translation: The consciousness of the spiritual warriors and the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, are shaped there. ||36||
lines.transliteration: tithai ghaReeaai suraa sidhaa kee sudh ||36||

lines.translation: In the realm of karma, the Word is Power.
No one else dwells there,
except the warriors of great power, the spiritual heroes.
They are totally fulfilled, imbued with the Lord's Essence.
Myriads of Sitas are there, cool and calm in their majestic glory.

lines.text: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਕਥਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.translation: Their beauty cannot be described.
lines.transliteration: taa ke roop na kathane jaeh ||

lines.text: ਨਾ ਓਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਨ ਠਾਗੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.translation: Neither death nor deception comes to those,
lines.transliteration: naa oh mareh na Thaage jaeh ||

lines.text: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.translation: within whose minds the Lord abides.
lines.transliteration: jin kai raam vasai man maeh ||

lines.translation: The devotees of many worlds dwell there.
They celebrate; their minds are imbued with the True Lord.
In the realm of Truth, the Formless Lord abides.
Having created the creation, He watches over it. By His Glance of Grace, He bestows happiness.
There are planets, solar systems and galaxies.

lines.text: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਥੈ ਤ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਅੰਤ ॥
lines.translation: If one speaks of them, there is no limit, no end.
lines.transliteration: je ko kathai ta a(n)t na a(n)t ||

lines.translation: There are worlds upon worlds of His Creation.

lines.text: ਜਿਵ ਜਿਵ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਵ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.translation: As He commands, so they exist.
lines.transliteration: jiv jiv hukam tivai tiv kaar ||

lines.translation: He watches over all, and contemplating the creation, He rejoices.
O Nanak, to describe this is as hard as steel! ||37||
Let self-control be the furnace, and patience the goldsmith.
Let understanding be the anvil, and spiritual wisdom the tools.
With the Fear of God as the bellows, fan the flames of tapa, the body's inner heat.
In the crucible of love, melt the Nectar of the Name,
and mint the True Coin of the Shabad, the Word of God.

lines.text: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.translation: Such is the karma of those upon whom He has cast His Glance of Grace.
lines.transliteration: jin kau nadhar karam tin kaar ||

lines.translation: O Nanak, the Merciful Lord, by His Grace, uplifts and exalts them. ||38||
